TextBlock.Text: A Fury EW aircraft trails a crewed F-14 by five nautical miles. An opposing F-14 transmits radar to the north. First observe with jamming off, then use the Fury escort jammer against that radar. Keep the supported F-14 inside the jammer cone. Compare contacts and illumination with jamming on and off. Both sides hold weapons unless you change their orders.

Fictional naval Fury variants. All aircraft wear black US Navy markings. Recon is the cleanest configuration; weapons increase the armed variants' fixed radar signature. Radar and ESM share contacts through native datalink.

Fury is a high-subsonic aircraft. Keep the crewed leader below its maximum speed. Use an explicit Vic pattern when creating mixed flights. Free engagements can split the formation; regroup after the attack.
